visual_synopsis: In a rural yard of cinderblock sheds two village men, one in a plaid shirt and one in an army jacket and flat cap, spend the whole sketch sprawled on the grass smoking, drinking and talking while sheep graze behind them. The film keeps cutting back to an old woman played in drag, in a white headscarf and striped jumper, who hauls a basin and a red bucket around the yard and complains to camera as the men do nothing.
